# Cture Image
**Image generation for DeepSeek Harness, without leaving the conversation.**

Text-to-image · image editing · batch generation — through any OpenAI-compatible
images API, rendere
d straight into the chat and saved to your workspace.
中文文档 · Changelog · Releases

*Prompt: “一只戴圆框眼镜的橘猫坐在书桌前敲代码…扁平化矢量插画风格” — generated by this plugin
(`gpt-image-2.5-sunburst`, 2K, 16

:9, high quality). It reported the real pixel size:
1672×941.*
## Features

- **Three tasks, one tool** — `generate` (text-to-image), `edit` (image-to-image
and inpainting, wit

h an optional mask) and `batch` (many prompts in one call,
bounded concurrency).
- **Pictures in the

conversation** — every result comes back as a real image
content block backed by a durable attachme

nt, so it displays inline and can be
downloaded. The untouched original bytes are written to your wo

rkspace as well.
- **Full parameter control** — model, quality, resolution tier, aspect ratio,
count

, save directory and whether to append rendering guidance.
- **Configured in the Plugins page** — th

e bundle ships a settings form with a
connectivity test that reports each step (`✓` / `✕`) before yo

u save. The API
key is stored on the host and never sent back to the browser.
- **Agent-drivable** —

an `imagegen_config` tool lets the model inspect and change
the same configuration from the convers

ation.
- **A proper DSH bundle** — appears under **Installed** in the Plugins page, can be
toggled l
ike any other bundle, and applies to every preset and session.
## Requirements
| DeepSeek Harness | **0.2.x** (desktop app or `dsh web`); built against the 0.2 bundle + client-mod

ule API |
| Node.js | **≥ 20** (only for the development scripts — the plugin itself runs inside DSH

) |
| An image endpoint | Any **OpenAI-compatible** images API (`POST /images/generations`, `POST /i
mages/edits`) and a key for it |
## Install

Download `cikian-dsh-cture-image-1.0.0.tgz` from the
Releases page, then point
the plugin manager at

Releases page, then point
the plugin manager at the file:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Both routes install the same package. The tarball carries the runtime files only —
no API key, and n
othing to configure before it runs.

> **Restart DSH after installing or moving the plugin.** The host half mounts
> immediately, but a b

undle's client half (the settings form, the image view) is
> composed into the page at boot. Install

ing into a page that is already open is
> the one situation where the plugin reports *running* while

its UI is missing.
> See Troubleshooting.

Verify the install: open **Plugins → Installed** — *Cture Image* should be listed
and switched on. I
ts detail page then shows the configuration form.
## Configure

Open **Plugins → Installed → Cture Image**. The form is rendered between the
description and the plu

ins → Installed → Cture Image**. The form is rendered between the
description and the plugin's rows.
| Field | Meaning |
| **Base URL** | Root of the OpenAI-compatible images API. Ships pointing at `https://api.cikhub.com

/v1`; any compatible endpoint works |
| **API key** | Your key. Stored on the host, shown back only

as `***set***` |
| **Model** | Default model; the dropdown is filled from `GET /models`, and free te

xt is accepted |
| **Quality** | `low` · `medium` · `high` · `xhigh` · `max` |
| **Resolution** | `1

K` · `2K` · `4K` (expressed as pixel sizes, see compatibility) |
| **Aspect ratio** | `1:1` · `2:3`

e directory** | Workspace-relative directory for the originals (default `saved-images`) |
| **Test c

onnectivity** | Probes the endpoint with the *draft* values and reports each step without saving |
|
**Test with one image** | Renders one cheap 1024×1024 image to prove the model and quota work |

**Where the configuration lives.** In `config.json` beside the installed package,
[该节后续省略]
## Endpoint compatibility

The plugin targets the OpenAI images API, but the details vary between providers
and relays. What ha
s been observed in practice, and how the plugin reacts:

- **Pixel sizes, not tier names.** Some endpoints ignore `size: "1K"` and
`aspect_ratio` entirely, s

o the plugin always sends concrete pixel dimensions
(`1024x1024`, `1536x1024`, `1024x1536`, …) and e

xpresses the ratio that way.
- **Some providers cap resolution around 1.6 MP** and silently scale a

large
request down (`2560×1440` → `1672×941`). The tool reports the **actual** size it
received, so

a capped result is visible instead of implied.
- **Extreme ratios may be clamped** server-side; `21:

9` can come back close to 2:1.
- **`edit` needs an endpoint that accepts multipart uploads** at `/im

ages/edits`.
If yours does not, `generate` still works.
- **Models are whatever your endpoint expose

s.** The built-in list is a hint, not
a constraint — use `imagegen_config action:"models"` to see th

lt-in list is a hint, not
a constraint — use `imagegen_config action:"models"` to see the real list.
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The client half has no `host.call` — that builtin belongs to *dynamic* plugins —
so the settings pag

e talks to the host over plain same-origin `fetch` against
routes the host registers via `ctx.webSer

ver`. Each route answers
`{ ok, value }` or `{ ok: false, error }`, so a failure renders as text ins

tead of
an empty form.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Security

- The API key lives in `config.json` beside the installed package and is excluded
from the published

tarball; `tools/publish-check.mjs` scans the shipped files for
key literals, bearer tokens and abso

lute local paths before any release.
- The settings form never receives the key — the host reports o

nly `***set***`.
- Found a problem? Please open an issue rather than posting a key. If a key is ever
exposed, rotate it — repository history and chat logs are forever.
